title: 한영 혼합 복수 전문 판단

input.modification: none; UTF8 exact bytes without BOM or trailing newline

frozenOracle.boundaryDecision: Frozen before model outputs; absent target does not erase request-type need

sourceSpecFields.입력: “Read-only로 queue의 duplicate delivery와 retry invariant를 분석하고, 누락을 잡는 test cases를 설계해 줘. No implementation, no code changes.”
sourceSpecFields.금지추천 또는 행동: 언어 전환 때문에 한 스킬만 추천; P로 자동 수정; test cases 요청을 테스트 실행 완료로 표현.
sourceSpecFields.보류조건: 분석 대상이 부족하면 입력 요청을 남기고 실행은 보류한다.
sourceSpecFields.통과기준: 세 스킬을 동시에 추천하고 역할·입출력 연결을 구분한다.
sourceSpecFields.증거: E0, 복수 label별 누락 및 불필요 추천.

steps.action: Receive parent-verified candidate publication, independent SOURCE verdict, common model/reasoning/API auth launch procedure and successful preflight evidence; stop if missing or inconsistent.

Prepare isolated exact candidate plugin and session-specific data paths; verify candidate commit/tree, plugin inventory and skills hashes. Do not build or modify product/generated output. Keep frozen oracle and historical outputs outside Claude accessible work directory.

Run exact base input with complete installed skill inventory and parent-approved model/auth/permissions. Capture actual host recommendation and AGENT selection independently; do not inject expected labels into prompt or substitute a mock/provider-only response.
Actually read selected CS, T and O skill bodies and applicable references through host tools. Record tool events and resolved file digests; Sol reading is not Claude read evidence.

Explain role handoff: CS analyzes duplicate/retry invariants and verification obligations; T uses these to design tests; O orders CS -> T and integrates read-only result. With absent queue target, ask for queue implementation/spec, ACK/retry policy and dedup identity/persistence boundary and defer concrete execution.

Compare each recommendation label, forbidden/notApplicable and unadjudicated scope against frozen oracle; retain omission/over-recommendation evidence. Verify no ponytail automatic implementation, no product/code changes, and no completed-test claim for designed test cases.

Record selected/read/applied/verified independently. Missing queue inputs can block concrete application/verification without erasing CS/T/O need. Keep recommendation assessment separate from end-to-end PASS; missing host evidence stays NOT_RUN or BLOCKED.
Account every paid attempt/cache/token/retry/failure, stop near budget, sanitize host evidence, hash and publish only SS14 unique run artifacts; reread immutable remote commit files.

costConservationReproduction.expected: Reject malformed RESP; preserve known actual cost 0.1, settle spentUsd=0.1 and release reservation

blockers: Verified candidate and independent SOURCE/remote publication evidence not received
Common explicit Claude model/reasoning and proven API authentication procedure not received
Common preflight/profile qualification and usage accounting settings not received
Concrete queue target/policy absent; frozen SS14 requires input request/defer behavior, not invented queue implementation
JEV allocation absent; JEV remains disabled
resumeOnlyWhen: Parent supplies verified candidate, common launch settings and preflight results; verify all G0 bindings before first paid call.
